# Release-generated final Result fixtures

These small synthetic files were generated by the actual Release native HDF5
encoder and `buildFinalResultArtifacts`, from Release commit
`097f0da0a81a8266cf794a445a4940e721f70f23` (its encoder/projection milestone is
`e417d3adbd28878ee05218b992b5f1f700dcfada`). `producer-input.json` contains every
canonical input document, its exact index and Result selection. No business data
or credentials are included. Each `artifact-ref.json` pins its manifest; the
manifest pins every compressed index and HDF5 byte stream.

The `lci-lcia` set has two exact versions of Result UUID ending `000001`.
Version `01.00.000` is derived from two source identities: reference Input -2 kg,
LCI Input values CN 2.7, GLO -3 and US 1e-30, plus one explicit zero Output; LCIA
is 42 kg CO2 equivalents. `01.00.001` has complete zero LCI and zero LCIA.
The `lci` set has a different final Result UUID ending `000010`, the same LCI
values and no LCIA capability. Source identities never act as Result row keys.

To regenerate, write `records[].document` to its matching `index.datasets[].path`
under a new canonical directory, then call Release `buildFinalResultArtifacts`
with that directory, this `index`, `results`, a new output path and the built
`release-result-hdf5` encoder. Copy each artifact directory by `impactCount`
into `lci` or `lci-lcia`, and save the four receipt fields
`schemaVersion,artifactId,manifestSha256,manifestByteSize` as `artifact-ref.json`.
New artifact UUIDs and native container bytes need not match; requalification must
compare logical axes and exact f64 values, and refresh all bound receipts.
